description: OOD eval-expansion sweep of the 2a_cascade checkpoints (145/146/147) on the 7 held-out 'val dataset' sources (docs/datasets/{isles22,shifts_ms,msd_hippocampus,msd_prostate,atlas_v2,gnc_kidney_lesions,hu_lwk1}.md). Per-source cascade ladder chosen from each dataset's own geometry (see those docs' 'crop_spacing_mm' sections): hu_lwk1/gnc_kidney reuse the exp92-era established ladder, isles22/shifts_ms/atlas_v2 use a whole-volume-coverage 2x ladder, msd_prostate uses a 3-level find-in-scene ladder, msd_hippocampus is single-level only (no cascade -- the native volumes are already pre-cropped to the ROI, so there is no wider context to localize against). All runs use eval.split=test, data.mask_downsample=occupancy, data.gpu_realize_crop=false (required overrides for these native-grid sources, which lack the totalseg-specific soft->occupancy eval remap). Run against ct_stats.json recomputed at pct_lo=2/pct_hi=98 (2026-09-24) to match the corresponding fix to totalsegmri's training-time mri_stats.json -- an earlier isles22 attempt (before this fix) was discarded, not included here.

runs.name: 145_cascade_randomfg_gtprior_regoff_hu_lwk1_ood
runs.description: 145 (registers=off, prior=perturbed-GT) on hu_lwk1 (CT, vertebra ROI), cascade [6,3,1]mm

runs.name: 145_cascade_randomfg_gtprior_regoff_isles22_ood
runs.description: 145 on isles22 (MRI DWI, stroke lesion), cascade [3,1.5]mm

runs.name: 145_cascade_randomfg_gtprior_regoff_msd_prostate_ood
